**Rowbase is live: spreadsheets to APIs in seconds**

Rowbase launched on March 4, 2026. It takes a CSV file and turns it into a live API you can query, with no setup.

When you upload a file, Rowbase immediately generates a clean, documented endpoint that your apps can call right away. It accepts five file formats, so you can probably use the data you already have as it is.

The free tier gives you 1,000 requests a day. That's enough to build, test and ship something without paying.

212 beta users tried Rowbase before launch, and their feedback changed almost every feature. Thanks to all of you for sticking with us from the start.

To try it, go to rowbase.dev and upload your first CSV. We'd love to see what you make with it.
